normal_public_user_install.commands_and_resources: Existing installed_smoke verifies actual prefix-owned gh/GHR, minimum gh, runtime/metadata/generated version1.5.0, nine schema resources and --help/--version.
normal_public_user_install.solver: Ordinary default public-channel create on the repository/cache filesystem using normal hardlinks; no direct file or staging install.
recovery_history: Initial cached public solve reported version absent; bounded full-index freshness revalidation found all25 normal public packages.
Temporary-filesystem transaction rolled back on host quota. The zero-record invalid orphan was unregistered through the Conda manager API; only its owned incomplete directory was deleted.

Concluded task-owned prefixes/downloads/fixtures removed; ordinary public solve/install then succeeded on the cache filesystem without metadata overrides. Shared caches, candidate file and required checks unchanged.
Initial smoke invocation used caller PATH and correctly rejected non-prefix gh; rerun outside source with the installed prefix PATH and no borrowed PYTHONPATH/user-site passed.

independent.scope: Exactly one source ZIP, independently downloaded and compared byte-for-byte by Git blob against every tracked source file. No wheel/sdist archival claim.

central_receiving.consumer_state: No automatic guide-copy, pin, registry or sibling worktree changes; separate owner receiving remains central.

limits: Source twelve-cell evidence is exact-commit, before authoritative tag creation; the real Conda1.5.0 file has twelve independent native installed cells,732 tests each.
Public wheel independently installed on Linux/Python3.14.7; do not relabel as twelve public-wheel installations.
The isolated exact public-tag extension is tested with checksum-bound gh2.48.0, separately from source Action/extension checks on three OS.
Zenodo archives exactly one source ZIP; all442 tracked source blobs and ZIP comment match the tag. No wheel/sdist archival claim.
Initial local fresh-user solver/index and host-quota failures, missing SDK bootstrap, wrong cwd and wrong PATH rehearsals are retained as uncredited history; corrected same-file receiving passes.
Global shared pip-check findings were pre-existing and not repaired; release prefixes have their own measured scope.
Final publication/guide closeout head CI is verified after push and recorded on #84; publication alone is not consumer adoption.
